system.description:
The riding skill is not a single skill. It is a group of related skills used when making rolls to control or stay on various riding animals in unusual circumstances. When spending a skill point on this skill, you must specify what sort of animal your character is skilled at riding. An exhaustive list of animals is not possible, but examples include:

■ Horse (includes mules and donkeys) ■ Camel ■ Elephant ■ Dire wolf ■ Griffon ■ Pegasus ■ Hippogriff ■ Giant eagle

Each skill point spent on a specific riding skill gives a +1 bonus to dexterity checks used to ride that type of animal. Generally, simply riding a calm animal as it walks shouldn't require a riding check. However, staying on an animal when it bolts or stumbles, or when it is damaged by an attack, should require a check – with the effective dexterity modified by the exact circumstances provoking the check.
